mechanism: Amphotericin B causes significant nephrotoxicity and electrolyte disturbances (hypokalemia, hypomagnesemia) which can potentiate fluoxetine-related hyponatremia and increase CNS toxicity; both drugs have cardiac arrhythmia potential compounded by electrolyte depletion.
action: Monitor serum electrolytes (sodium, potassium, magnesium) closely, assess renal function regularly, consider ECG monitoring, and watch for signs of serotonin syndrome or increased CNS effects; use lipid formulations of amphotericin B to minimize nephrotoxicity if possible.
